facts.business: Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. is a diversified Indian public sector enterprise engaged in manufacturing businesses (industrial packaging, greases & lubricants, leather chemicals) and service businesses (travel & logistics, logistics infrastructure, cold chain).
key_risks: Board composition non-compliance: insufficient Independent Directors and Woman Director as per Listing Regulations and DPE Guidelines
Audit Committee and other committee composition non-compliance during periods in FY 2025-26
Subsidiary Visakhapatnam Port Logistics Park Limited (VPLPL) net worth eroded by ~73% as on 31.03.2026; additional provision of ₹1,015.25 lakhs made on investment
VPLPL facing teething problems, delayed CFS license, Covid-19 impact, and challenges in achieving expected growth
Corporate Guarantee issued to PFCL for VPLPL debt servicing; carrying value of financial guarantee obligation ₹695.45 lakhs as on 31.03.2026
facts.related_party_note: Joint ventures: Lawrie Van Leer Limited and PT. Balmer Lawrie Indonesia (equal nominee representatives on Board). Subsidiary: Visakhapatnam Port Logistics Park Limited (60% equity). Capital commitments for JV/Associate companies: ₹9,498.19 lakhs (₹4,775.28 lakhs previous year).
